questions.prompt: Does the Moon make its own light?
choices: The Moon makes no light of its own.
The Moon makes all sunlight by itself.
The Moon makes a new Sun each night.
questions.answer: The Moon makes no light of its own.
questions.evidenceText: The Moon makes no light of its own.

questions.prompt: Which sentence tells about a crescent in The Moon?
choices: A crescent shows part of the Moon's sunlit face.
The Moon makes no light of its own.
By day or night, moonlight is reflected sunlight.
questions.answer: A crescent shows part of the Moon's sunlit face.
questions.evidenceText: A crescent shows part of the Moon's sunlit face.

questions.prompt: What is the big idea of The Moon?
choices: By day or night, moonlight is reflected sunlight.
Only the Moon makes no light of its own.
Only a crescent shows part of the Moon's sunlit face.
questions.answer: By day or night, moonlight is reflected sunlight.
questions.rationale: The Moon makes no light of its own. A crescent shows part of the Moon's sunlit face. By day or night, moonlight is reflected sunlight. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: By day or night, moonlight is reflected sunlight.
